bead.title: Extract commit-transition scenarios into shared pqueue-conformance scenarios
bead.description:
PROBLEM
The behavioral proof that CommitTransitionPort actually works (side records written, lifecycle items enqueued, instance fence advanced, claim finalized, all atomically; request-id replay/conflict; recovery reads) lives only in crates/pqueue-sqlite/tests/relational_commit.rs (7 tests) and crates/pqueue-memory/src/tests.rs (14 tests), copy-pasted per backend rather than shared. A new backend (or postgres, once it implements this port) would need someone to remember to copy/adapt these tests by hand.

PROPOSED FIX
Add scenario functions to crates/pqueue-conformance/src/scenarios.rs generalizing the sqlite/memory tests: writes side records + enqueues lifecycle items + advances instance fence + finalizes claim atomically; rejects bad token/version without writing; request-id replay does not double-write; explain_commit recovers the transition and survives reopen. Gate each scenario on the backend's advertised `commit_capabilities()`: when a capability is true, run the full positive scenario; when false, run the decline-consistency check from the sibling bead (pqueue-0ef6807b) instead, so the SAME call site exercises whichever path is correct for that backend -- no separate "skip" branching left to the test author.
Extend ConformanceBackend (or add a sibling trait, e.g. ConformanceCommitTransition: ConformanceBackend + CommitTransitionPort + RecoveryReadPort) so any backend that already runs the shared conformance macros picks this up automatically.

IN-SCOPE FILES
- crates/pqueue-conformance/src/scenarios.rs
- crates/pqueue-conformance/src/lib.rs (new trait bound / macro if needed)

OUT-OF-SCOPE
- Wiring the new scenario into each backend's test files (next bead).
- Deleting the existing sqlite/memory bespoke test files in this bead (do that in the wiring bead once the shared version is proven equivalent, to avoid a window with no coverage).
bead.acceptance:
1. `rg -n 'fn commit_transition' crates/pqueue-conformance/src/scenarios.rs` finds new capability-gated scenario function(s).
2. A local invocation of the new scenario against `pqueue_sqlite::composed_sqlite_relational_backend` (or equivalent) passes and reproduces the same assertions as the existing crates/pqueue-sqlite/tests/relational_commit.rs suite.
3. `cargo test -p pqueue-conformance` (or the crate exercising the new scenario) passes.
4. `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass.
